why_ai: Unlicensed engineering services whose transformation code AI coding agents increasingly write.
why_clarity: Strong engineering practice, but whether assets get used is never measured.
why_digital: Code and data platforms built remotely and delivered as digital assets.

why_ai: Cost attribution and query optimisation are computable from platform metadata.
why_clarity: Cost shows up directly and objectively on the consumption bill.
why_digital: Query logs and billing data analysed in software.

why_ai: Mechanical CI and environment work, identical on every engagement.
why_clarity: A deployment either breaks a report or passes tests, instantly.
why_digital: Pipelines, environments and tests exist only in code.

why_ai: Answering which assets are used is a query over logs that software runs.
why_clarity: Query logs give an objective count of each asset's use.
why_digital: Lineage and query logs analysed remotely on screen.

why_ai: Scoping a multi-year programme is a high-stakes call clients want a trusted firm to own.
why_clarity: Whether scoping was right is known only years into the programme.
why_digital: Warehouse logic and reports assessed on screen, sold through programme leadership.

why_ai: Documentation and semantic search generated from code and lineage are what LLMs do.
why_clarity: Generated descriptions and search hits are checkable against the code.
why_digital: Code, lineage and usage turned into a searchable catalogue.

why_ai: Deletion needs an accountable owner to accept breakage risk beyond what lineage shows.
why_clarity: Removal is clear, but hidden dependencies make proving safety uncertain.
why_digital: Assets, lineage and approvals are all digital.

why_ai: Distribution and semantic drift detection is a statistical monitoring task for software.
why_clarity: Semantic breaks are definable but often surface only when a number looks wrong.
why_digital: Data pipelines monitored and alerted entirely in software.

why_ai: Tracing lineage across inherited models is code reading that AI agents handle well.
why_clarity: Add-a-column requests recur and pass or fail against tests.
why_digital: Reading and writing transformation code on screen.

why_ai: Same failures, same rerun and backfill sequence, same explanation message.
why_clarity: Pipeline either recovers before morning reports or does not.
why_digital: Overnight pipeline recovery done remotely on screen.

why_ai: Joining query logs, lineage and cost data is a reporting job software performs.
why_clarity: Usage counts are objective facts from logs the platform already emits.
why_digital: Platform telemetry joined into a reporting product.
